login.title: Sign in
login.locked: Account locked. Try again in {{minutes}} min
login.tagline: From the first order to the last rupee, in one calm place.
login.f1: Tables, kitchen tickets and bills stay in step on every device.
login.f2: Every payment, discount and refund is on record and cannot be edited.
login.f3: Urdu and English screens, and receipts your guests can read.
login.footer: Runs on your own network. Taking orders and printing bills never needs the internet.

dash.title: Business overview
dash.empty: No sales or costs in this period yet. Figures appear here as soon as bills are paid and expenses are entered.
dash.uncosted: {{count}} sold dishes have no recipe, so their ingredient cost is missing and profit looks higher than it is. Add recipes under Admin → Recipes.
dash.plHint: From sales to what you keep
dash.noExpenses: No expenses recorded. Enter them under Admin → Costs.
dash.taxNote: Tax collected for the authority: {{amount}}. It is not part of sales or profit.
dash.lossNote: Costs are more than sales in this period
dash.purchasesNote: Stock bought in this period: {{amount}}. It becomes cost of food when the dishes are sold, so it is not counted twice.
dash.trend: Sales and gross profit by day
dash.trendHint: Bars are net sales; the line is what is left after food cost
dash.hoursHint: Net sales by hour; the dark bar is the busiest
dash.topItemsHint: By sales. Margin is what is left after ingredient cost.
dash.controlsHint: Things that cost money or deserve a second look
dash.cDiscountsD: {{bills}} bills, {{pct}} of sales, {{approved}} approved by a manager
dash.cVoids: Dishes voided after the kitchen had them
dash.cNoSaleD: every one is logged with a reason
dash.cPaidOut: Cash paid out of the drawer
dash.positionHint: Not limited to the period above
dash.howTitle: How these numbers are worked out
dash.how1: Net sales = menu sales − discounts + service charge − refunds. Tax is excluded.
dash.how2: Cost of food = the ingredient cost of every dish sold, from its recipe and the average purchase price.
dash.how3: Net profit = net sales − cost of food − expenses entered under Costs. Salaries and rent only reduce profit once they are entered as expenses.
dash.how4: Days follow the business day, so a late night after midnight still counts for the day it opened.
dash.how5: Everything comes from paid bills and recorded entries. Nothing here can be edited.
dash.tip: Rent and salaries are counted on the day they are entered, so a single day can show a loss. Choose This month for the true picture.
dash.kitchenHint: How long a ticket takes from the moment it is sent to the moment the kitchen marks it ready.
dash.kitchenNone: No timed tickets in this period ({{sent}} sent). Times appear once the kitchen taps Start and Ready on the kitchen screen.
dash.kMedianSub: Median of {{n}} tickets, sent to ready
dash.kCaveat: {{untimed}} tickets were never marked ready on the screen and {{ignored}} took over 3 hours (likely forgotten taps). They are left out of these times.

qr.hint: A QR code on each table opens today's menu on the guest's phone. Nothing to install, no sign-in, and it only shows the menu.
qr.liveHint: Anyone who scans the QR code sees today's menu and prices.
qr.offHint: Scanning the code shows "menu not available". Switch on when you are ready.
qr.addressHint: This is the address inside the QR code. Guests use the restaurant Wi-Fi, so it must be the till computer's address on your network (for example http://192.168.1.10), or your website if the menu is online.
qr.addressBad: Start with http:// or https:// followed by the address.
qr.localWarn: "localhost" only works on this computer. A guest's phone cannot open it: use the till computer's network address instead.
qr.noteHint: Shown at the top of the menu, for example today's special, or "Karahi ready after 7 pm". Leave empty for none.
qr.posterUr: آج کا مینو دیکھنے کے لیے اسکین کریں
qr.needAddress: Enter a valid address to see the code
qr.printHint: Print on A5 or A4 and put one on every table. Dishes you mark unavailable show as sold out on guests' phones within a minute.
